_comment: Autofill selector pack — docs/Application-Architecture.md §6.4. Served from OUR server, never compiled into the app, so a DOM change is a config push in an hour rather than an app update rural users never install. Every step falls back to spoken guided-paste when its selector does not match, so a stale pack degrades instead of breaking. We never automate submit, login, OTP, payment or CAPTCHA — we fill fields, the artisan presses the button. Ships disabled; flip `enabled` once match-rate holds above 95% for a week. Selectors below are PLACEHOLDERS and must be read off the real portal before this is turned on.
